description:
You are an architectural visualization artist working on a building façade. The scene contains a solid 'Wall' object and three red cutter objects ('WindowCutter_Left', 'WindowCutter_Right', 'DoorCutter') positioned where openings should be.

Your task:
1. Select the 'Wall' object.
2. Add a Boolean modifier (Difference) for EACH of the three cutter objects to cut holes in the wall.
3. Apply the modifiers to make the geometry changes permanent.
4. Hide or delete the three cutter objects so they are not visible in the viewport or render.
5. Render the scene from the current camera view (F12) and save the image to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/wall_render.png'.
6. Save the Blender project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/wall_with_openings.blend'.

Login: The desktop session is active. Blender is open with the scene loaded.
